topic.source_contract: ONR nuclear-site land-use-planning consultation zones, emergency planning, population effects, external hazards and decision evidence

facts.zones: site, DEPZ, OCZ, 12km and special-case consultation routes
facts.guard: zone location is not an ONR objection or planning outcome

facts.emergency: ONR regulates emergency preparedness at nuclear sites
facts.guard: emergency-plan existence is not development acceptance
site licence status is not planning permission for nearby development

facts.REPPIR: radiation emergency preparedness and public-information framework
facts.guard: DEPZ is not a generic exclusion zone

facts.research: consultation distances consider emergency planning and external hazards
facts.guard: distance alone is not a decision

scope_guards: Location within an ONR consultation zone is not treated as an objection or refusal.
Location outside a standard zone is not treated as no-consultation where a special case applies.
A DEPZ is not treated as a universal development exclusion zone.
An ONR response is not treated as planning permission.
Emergency-plan capacity is not inferred from population totals alone.
A nuclear-site licence is not treated as approval of surrounding development.
Consultation distance is not treated as exact hazard consequence modelling.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, zone, criteria, ONR/local-authority response, emergency-plan assurance and planning decision.
